verifications.claim: Integrity is the name of the Orion spacecraft used for NASA's Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The flight aboard a spacecraft named Integrity'; R2: 'Orion, named Integrity'; R3: 'The Artemis II crew members named their Orion spacecraft Integrity'; R4: 'The Orion spacecraft for this mission – named Integrity by its astronaut crew'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state that Integrity is the name of the Orion spacecraft for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: URL '/2026/04/01/...', 'blasted off... on Wednesday evening', 'For an April 1 launch'; R2: URL '/2026/04/01/...', launch at '6:35 p.m.'; R4: URL '2026-04-01', 'launched... at 6:35 p.m. ET today'
